decisions.decision: The committee agreed that the job evaluation be based on the job description, and made changes to both the job description and the job evaluation.
decisions.quote: the committee agreed that the job evaluation be based on the job description and made changes to both documents.

decisions.decision: The committee agreed to Fred Crellin's suggestion that the job evaluation tool be broken down into major categories (Fiscal Planning and Management, Compliance and Risk Management, Supervision and Leadership, Communication, Program Development and Personal Characteristics and Development), and thanked him for his input.
decisions.quote: the committee agreed and thanked fred for his input.

decisions.decision: Deb Seeley will make the changes to the job evaluation tool and bring the revised documents to the next meeting for approval.
decisions.quote: deb will make the changes to the job evaluation tool and bring the revised documents to the next meeting for approval.
